none: PAS LIN-E4052C: Early Medieval lead plaque
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An irregular sheet of lead, possibly a plaque, and possibly of Middle to Late Saxon date. The item has a flat, rectangular body, with a broadly straight terminal at one end, and a pointed terminal at the other end.
